title: Mentor Matching and Schedule Optimizer
description: Five mentors, five students, seven scored pairings, and three candidate slots -- only one of which passes every constraint.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: AI-Customized Curriculum and Rolling Out New Agents

educational.audience: Club leaders evaluating AI matching and scheduling assistance

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a mentor-student matching graph and a set of candidate schedule slots, the learner examines the scores to identify the strongest mentor-student pairing and the schedule slot that satisfies every stated constraint.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click-to-explore bipartite matching graph plus constraint-checked schedule slots, with a combined best-answer reveal
pedagogical.assessment: Point to two equally scored pairings and ask which to choose, and what information would be needed to decide.
